attr.title: Katana ZERO
attr.desc: Experimental Android 1.1.10 compatibility port for RG35XX-H / KNULLI. Native controls and local saves; full-game, audio and clean-exit validation pending.
attr.inst: Extract katanazero.zip into Ports. Copy your Katana ZERO Netflix 1.1.10 ARM64 XAPK to ports/katanazero/katana-zero-1.1.10.xapk. Launch Katana ZERO; first-time setup is automatic.
attr.inst_md:
1. Extract **katanazero.zip** into **Ports**.
2. Copy your **Katana ZERO Netflix 1.1.10 ARM64 XAPK** to `ports/katanazero/katana-zero-1.1.10.xapk`.
3. Launch **Katana ZERO**; first-time setup is automatic.
